# Niche Scoring

## Procedure
Score demand 0-5, repeatability 0-5, monetization 0-5, originality 0-5; score competition and production difficulty 0-5 as costs. Document assumptions and use scripts/shortslab.py score.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
